style: Match the approved C_badge_clue.jpg: photorealistic cinematic urban noir, believable East Asian cast in an old rain-soaked city; blue-gray shadows, restrained warm amber practical lighting, subtle cyan violet reflections, tactile materials, film still quality, shallow depth of field when appropriate. NOT polygonal, vector, cartoon, anime, flat silhouette, sketch or impasto painting. No readable words, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no UI. Preserve clear subjects. All assets belong to one consistent detective game.
